mapper.sql: select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.order_num, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by from sys_dept d
mapper.select: select r.role_id, r.role_key, r.status, r.del_flag from sys_role r where r.role_key = #{roleKey} order by r.role_id limit 1
select m.perms from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.menu_type = 'F' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''

select case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.dept_id) else null end as dept_id, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.parent_id) else null end as parent_id, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.ancestors) else null end as ancestors, max(d.dept_name) as dept_name, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.dept_code) else null end as dept_code, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.order_num) else null end as order_num, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.status) else null end as status, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.del_flag) else null end as del_flag, case when count(*) = 1 then max(d.create_by) else null end as create_by from sys_dept d where d.dept_name = #{deptName} having count(*) > 0
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept (parent_id, ancestors, dept_name, dept_code, order_num, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{deptName}, #{deptCode}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.user_type, u.status, u.del_flag, u.create_by, u.remark from sys_user u where u.user_name = #{userName} order by case when u.user_type = #{testUserType} and u.create_by = #{createdBy} and u.remark like concat(#{userMarker}, '%') then 1 else 0 end, case when u.del_flag = '0' then 0 else 1 end, u.user_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (dept_id, user_name, nick_name, user_type, email, phonenumber, sex, avatar, password, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{userType}, #{email}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{avatar}, #{password}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select role_id from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId} order by role_id
mapper.update: update sys_user set dept_id = #{deptId}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
